text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: paging: KV cache eviction surge + cont-batch timeouts on prod-east. 5xx rate up ~4x on /v1/generate. Alerting owners and running impact assessment.

maya (on-call): I'm on it. collecting traces now, tagging @jamal and @anita.

jamal (eng-sre): I see huge KV cache evict counts and continuous-batcher timeouts in the last 30m. Correlates with a rollout earlier. Any deploys or config changes at ~1769996700?

anita (eng-runtime): We did a canary push for cont-batching profile at 1769996700 — changed max_num_seqs from 128 -> 2048 to optimize throughput for long-context workloads. commit 9a7c4f1.

leo (eng-ml): That jump can massively increase KV cache working set and cause eviction storms. We're seeing a performance cliff at ~750 tokens where latency and evictions spike.

maya (on-call): Ok. mitigation plan: 1) revert max_num_seqs to safe value 2) scale kv-cache pool up +20% 3) if needed, temporarily disable continuous batching for /v1/generate -> model:open-l2 route.

jamal (eng-sre): Preparing rollback patch now. Will coordinate with runtime to avoid thrashing.

ops-bot: runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-eviction (steps for scaling kvpool, config rollback, routing fallback).

anita (eng-runtime): Logs: 
```
[cont-batcher] timestamp=1769998723 max_num_seqs=2048 active_batches=280 kv_evictions=23000/s batch_timeout_ms=12000
[serving] region=prod-east 500s=3.9% -> spike
```

jamal (eng-sre): Hotfix command I'm about to run (dry run):
```
kubectl patch configmap cont-batching -n redwood -p '{"data":{"max_num_seqs":"128","max_batch_tokens":"4096"}}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/cont-batcher -n redwood
```
Applying in 30s.

anita (eng-runtime): Also scaling kv-cache ASG: current=40 -> target=48 (api call executed).

maya (on-call): Smart-routing change to prefer model:open-l1 for latency-sensitive tenants going out now to shed load on the mem-heavy variant.

leo (eng-ml): I pushed a note linking the problematic commit: https://git.redwood/changes/9a7c4f1 — we should add a preflight that flags max_num_seqs > 512 for prod.

jamal (eng-sre): Patch applied and rollouts started. Observing metrics.

anita (eng-runtime): Confirming cont-batcher pods are restarting gracefully. A few older pods had stale cache pointers, restarting them cleared errors.

jamal (eng-sre): Metrics update: error rate down by ~50% within 4 minutes of rollback; latency nearing baseline after ~8 minutes; kv_evictions dropping steadily.

emily (customer-success): Noting we have customer reports from Partner X about intermittent 5xxs. Drafting status update.

maya (on-call): Can you include an ETA and whether their traffic was routed to fallback? Also note affected window.

emily (customer-success): Draft: "We saw intermittent 5xx errors between 1769996700 and 1769998920 caused by an internal configuration change to continuous batching. Mitigation is in place; we're following up with a postmortem and remediation timeline." Sending now.

anita (eng-runtime): One small issue: 6 cont-batcher pods required hard restart due to stuck eviction loops. Done.

jamal (eng-sre): For safety, I'm disabling cont-batching on the /v1/generate route for 20m while we observe:
```
PATCH /routing
{"route":"/v1/generate","cont_batching":{"enabled":false}}
```

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Status changed to mitigation in progress. Severity lowered to Sev2.

maya (on-call): Handing off to night on-call @leo in 30m. Please monitor kv_evictions, cont_batch_queue_length, batch_timeout_ms.

leo (eng-ml): Acknowledged. Will keep dashboards open and watch for regressions.

emily (customer-success): Sent customer follow-up acknowledging mitigation and promising postmortem.

maya (on-call): Action items before close: - postmortem + timeline with config diff - add pre-deploy checks for cont-batching (max_num_seqs / max_batch_tokens) - add canary guard in rollout scripts - add perf-harness test that triggers KV eviction growth when seqs/batches scale up.

jamal (eng-sre): Opened incident ticket DOC-1769998765 and a PR for deployment guardrails.

anita (eng-runtime): Added alert: cont-batcher.max_num_seqs > 512 AND kv_evictions > 1000/s -> page on-call.

leo (eng-ml): Follow-up: we should evaluate default max_batch_tokens for long-seq models; reducing it prevents huge single-batch memory pressure.

maya (on-call): Final note before handoff: root cause = misconfigured canary that accelerated max_num_seqs into prod without staged capacity testing or validation. Recommend blocking large config changes without staged mem-profile testing.

ops-bot: runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/continuous-batching-misconfig

maya (on-call): Closing this thread in incidents log; migrating details to the postmortem doc. I'll update last_message_ts when final notes are posted.
